cases.question: Which business records are publicly discoverable in Agri Samaj, and who controls publication?
May the Agri Samaj assistant read private applications or execute account actions?
Against what set does Agri Samaj validate the source identifiers returned by its assistant?
What ownership checks precede storing an Agri Samaj business mutation, and how are profile and audit changes stored?
Which JWT properties and current account properties does an authenticated Agri Samaj request check?
Which Agri Samaj business directory filters are available, and can a visitor preserve filters or keep a private shortlist?
What authorizes an Agri Samaj generated voice reply, and how are its provider requests bounded?
What password length does Agri Samaj administrator seeding require, and does seeding overwrite existing accounts?
Which database isolation does the Agri Samaj browser runner use, and are provider calls on by default?
Where should Agri Samaj private uploads live on Vercel and when self-hosting?
What supporting identity document did the owner of the latest Agri Samaj business application upload?
What exact rupee amount is the Agri Samaj premium advertisement package today?
In the durable-effects lab, what must commit before ingestion may return HTTP 202?
In the durable-effects lab, how do leased relays and worker commit ordering handle duplicate queue delivery?
What happens in the catalog lab when a retry uses the same idempotency key with the same input versus changed input?
In the catalog lab, can a positive Redis cache entry authorize a revoked session, and which store is authoritative?
How stale can the catalog lab cache be, and what happens during Redis failure or fallback overload?
Does the durable-effects lab document an operating cloud deployment or independently proven local fault domains?
How does the durable-effects lab isolate repeatedly failing jobs, and how is redrive represented?
What CPU, memory and worker allocations distinguish the lab vertical and horizontal serving profiles?
What identity and evidence connect the lab tested container image to production promotion?
Which stale-address connection timeout, upstream-attempt bound and total retry budget does the lab gateway document?
How many seconds did the lab measured multi-AZ cloud failover take during its last production outage?
Which payment processor settles stock purchases in the durable-effects catalog lab?

encoder_input_diagnostics.interpretation: Production encoder truncates each chunk to 256 tokens. Original heading chunking is preserved; BM25 still sees full chunk text.

dataset.label: Authored multi-domain diagnostic heldout query partition; not an external benchmark or independent human labels

protocol.aggregation: macro mean over answerable queries; unsupported queries excluded from ranking metrics
protocol.cold_scope: one fresh evaluator process; import and index construction separated; OS/filesystem caches not cleared; first method calls share one index
protocol.latency_scope: local retrieval calls only; excludes HTTP, network, generation, rate limiting and model downloads
protocol.limitations: Five domains from six public repository documents by the same author. Not an external benchmark, independently human-labeled dataset, production traffic or generated-answer evaluation. Domain-separated query diagnostic splits; all documents are available to retrieval. The durable-jobs source describes an implementation lab with undeployed cloud operation. Production retrieval is unchanged apart from explicit corpus injection. No ranking or threshold tuning before this frozen diagnostic. Thirteen of 32 chunks exceed the encoder 256-token limit; complete source chunks remain available to BM25 and generation context.
protocol.relevance: binary; unlisted chunks treated as non-relevant
